meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided to put a zero in my son's gradebook before anyone picked up a phone and called me?
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.
"Your son cheated." I'm writing that down, word for word. Then prove it, Hale, and if it's a percentage from a piece of software, save us both the time.
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.

I don't explain anything I haven't seen, Hale. Turn the screen around so I can read the dates on that history myself. And "pasted" from where, exactly, because a student can write in one place and paste into another.
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.

Read me the line, exactly as it appears in Owen's essay. A misquoted line is a careless student, Hale, not a cheating one. I'm writing down Act 3 Scene 2, and I still haven't seen that version history.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.

My son does not lie, Hale, and you don't get to tell me what he said to me. You've shown me nothing yet, not one page, and you're already calling him a liar to his mother's face. Turn that screen around now, or I'm walking upstairs to the principal before my call.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

Take it or leave it is not how your own procedure works, Hale: 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and nobody did. The zero comes off, I get an apology for how Owen found out, and you show me those pages. And before anything else, tell me whether there is something on his record right now.
I'm the one waiting, Hale. Is there anything on Owen's record, yes or no?
